name: Run scripts
description: Runs your own scripts when Aurral sends a notification or adds a track. Pick scripts for each event below. Keep both events under Adds turned on: an event with no scripts listed already does nothing.

settings.label: Scripts folder
settings.help: The folder that holds your scripts, as Aurral sees it, for example /scripts. Only files inside it can run. Mount it read-only.

settings.label: Discover updated
settings.help: When the daily Discover recommendations refresh. Script names, separated by commas. Example: notify.sh, scan.py. Leave blank to run nothing.

settings.label: Flow finished
settings.help: When a flow finishes its downloads. Script names, separated by commas.

settings.label: Request made
settings.help: When someone requests an album. Script names, separated by commas.

settings.label: Request available
settings.help: When a requested album is downloaded, or was already on disk. Script names, separated by commas.

settings.label: Artist added
settings.help: When someone adds an artist to the Library. Script names, separated by commas.

settings.label: Track added
settings.help: Once for each track Aurral adds to the Library, flow tracks included. Script names, separated by commas.

settings.label: Timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long a script may run before it and everything it started are stopped. Default 60, up to 3600.

settings.label: Test runs the scripts
settings.help: When on, Test also runs every script listed above once, with the event scriptTest and sample values.
